Retrieved from the author's public download folders on 2026-09-13:
Women: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1720N9IGyQHXYvtvZJzazhxtTTlz-y2Vf
Humanoid Rig.blend: 1mV7EzppVF2f4_jx37394ardiKlDUA6YD
Men: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1USAAquX2JJWuA2m6zol0KUkFe3UkZ8zX
Humans_Master.blend: 1lDSKTJX1CR15qo9JAFHFjRFGR7rp8K8D

female.blend and male.blend contain the relevant complete casual/formal
character meshes and original rest skeleton, extracted without geometry
modification. Unused characters and animations are omitted.

Sunny Life modifications are generated by art/blender/modular_resident.py:
body, neck, head, hands, legs, shoes and hair use the source meshes;
rest-pose fitting maps them to the existing interaction skeleton;
material roles support existing color swatches and outfit/hair selection.
Every source body is kept as authored geometry, not replaced with primitives.
The gameplay animation tracks, interaction IK and glasses/fork are project work.

Support the author: https://www.patreon.com/quaternius
